claim: Alphabet's filing lists $100.1 billion for net income in Q4 2024.
summary: Alphabet's $100.1B net income figure is for full-year 2024, not Q4 2024; Q4 2024 net income was ~$26.5B, so attributing $100.1B to Q4 is false.

sub_claims.text: Alphabet's filing lists approximately $100.1 billion as net income (full-year 2024 total).
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge Alphabet's 2024 10-K reports FY2024 net income ~$100.12B, rounded to $100.1B. The figure exists but as annual total.

sub_claims.text: The $100.1 billion net income figure pertains to Q4 2024 as a quarterly period.
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge Q4 2024 net income was ~$26.5B; $100.1B is the full-year 2024 total, not the Q4 quarter.
